channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Pilot Survives Small Plane Crash Off Florida Coast
item.description: A small plane went down near Boca Raton, Florida, with only the pilot aboard.

item.title: Hawk Fire rapidly grows to 10,000 acres, prompting evacuations near Reno
item.description: Officials reported that roughly 1,000 homes were at risk.

item.title: Video shows dramatic rescue in remote Pacific waters
item.description: All 27 fishermen were saved after their Ecuadorian-flagged vessel caught fire over 500 miles southwest of the Galapagos Islands.

item.title: Iran warns that nations joining U.S. sanctions will be seen as 'enemies'
item.description: The new head of Iran's supreme national security council cautioned countries participating in the U.S. economic pressure against Tehran.
